title: Law enforcement to retain other authority.
bodyText: The provisions of this part shall not affect the ability of a law enforcement officer to remove firearms or ammunition from any person pursuant to other lawful authority.
bodyHtml: [§134-71]  Law enforcement to retain other authority.  The provisions of this part shall not affect the ability of a law enforcement officer to remove firearms or ammunition from any person pursuant to other lawful authority. [L 2019, c 150, pt of §2]
